{{Quote|The guardian beasts called tuk'ata...possess great tactical intelligence and can live for centuries without feeding. I would have died in the Tomb of Din Grrut had I not fed a Sith slave to the tuk'ata.|Extract from [[Sorzus Syn]]'s [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]], [[6900 BBY]]|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''Tomb of Din Gruut''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] that [[Sorzus Syn]] explored in her life. Syn remarked that she would have died in this tomb, home to [[Din Grrut]], if she had not fed a Sith [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] to the [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]].<ref name="BoS" />
